events.title: Crusaders defeat a Fatimid army at Ascalon
events.description: A month after taking Jerusalem, the crusaders surprised and routed an Egyptian relief army near Ascalon. The victory, the last battle of the First Crusade, secured the new Latin kingdom.
events.html: A month after taking Jerusalem, the crusaders surprised and routed an Egyptian relief army near Ascalon. The victory, the last battle of the First Crusade, secured the new Latin kingdom.

events.title: Frederick the Great is crushed at Kunersdorf
events.description: A Russian and Austrian army destroyed Frederick II's Prussian force near Frankfurt an der Oder. Frederick wrote that all was lost, but his enemies failed to follow up and Prussia survived.
events.html: A Russian and Austrian army destroyed Frederick II's Prussian force near Frankfurt an der Oder. Frederick wrote that all was lost, but his enemies failed to follow up and Prussia survived.

events.title: Isaac Singer patents his improved sewing machine
events.description: Isaac Singer received a US patent for a sewing machine with an up-and-down needle and foot treadle. Sold on instalment plans, Singer machines brought sewing machines into homes worldwide.
events.html: Isaac Singer received a US patent for a sewing machine with an up-and-down needle and foot treadle. Sold on instalment plans, Singer machines brought sewing machines into homes worldwide.

events.title: SS troops massacre villagers at Sant'Anna di Stazzema
events.description: Waffen-SS soldiers killed some 560 civilians, many of them women and children, in the Tuscan village of Sant'Anna di Stazzema. It was one of the worst atrocities of the German occupation of Italy.
events.html: Waffen-SS soldiers killed some 560 civilians, many of them women and children, in the Tuscan village of Sant'Anna di Stazzema. It was one of the worst atrocities of the German occupation of Italy.

events.title: IBM launches its Personal Computer
events.description: IBM unveiled the IBM PC model 5150, running Microsoft's MS-DOS. Its open design was widely copied, and 'PC compatible' machines came to dominate business and home computing.
events.html: IBM unveiled the IBM PC model 5150, running Microsoft's MS-DOS. Its open design was widely copied, and 'PC compatible' machines came to dominate business and home computing.

events.title: Russian submarine Kursk sinks in the Barents Sea
events.description: Explosions in its torpedo compartment sent the nuclear submarine Kursk to the seabed, killing all 118 crew. Russia's slow response and refusal of early foreign help caused national anger.
events.html: Explosions in its torpedo compartment sent the nuclear submarine Kursk to the seabed, killing all 118 crew. Russia's slow response and refusal of early foreign help caused national anger.
